description: tools/test-projects/localization (WEB_PROJECT=localization tools/build.sh web): String Tables read as JSON, the game language resolved from navigator.languages ['de'] (game-ui-localization.md R7), then re-resolved when the page dispatches languagechange with ['ja'] four seconds in (R10, AC15). No pixel check: the scene is empty.
init_script: (function(){ var langs = ['de']; Object.defineProperty(Navigator.prototype, 'languages', {get: function(){ return langs; }, configurable: true}); Object.defineProperty(Navigator.prototype, 'language', {get: function(){ return langs[0]; }, configurable: true}); setTimeout(function(){ langs = ['ja']; window.dispatchEvent(new Event('languagechange')); }, 4000); })();
